- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The museum could benefit from an engaging and educational interactive dinosaur encyclopedia that presents relevant information in an accessible, immersive, and entertaining way.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The goal of the project is to design and develop an interactive dinosaur encyclopedia that enhances the learning experience for visitors at the Naturalis Museum.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The interactive dinosaur encyclopedia will be designed to complement and enhance the existing dinosaur exhibits, providing additional layers of information and interactive experiences that cater to a diverse range of visitors, particularly children.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The project will follow a user-centered design approach, focusing on the needs and preferences of the Naturalis Museum's visitors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The process will involve four main phases: research, concepting, design, and testing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The final product will align with the museum's core values and objectives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The project will be set within the Naturalis Museum, a national museum of history in Leiden.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The interactive dinosaur encyclopedia will provide an engaging, educational, and enjoyable experience that embodies the spirit of Naturalis' mission: "Together, we discover the richness of nature."

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The encyclopedia should be visually appealing, easy to navigate, and age-appropriate, incorporating various multimedia elements and interactive features.
